description: High-beginner business English for building confidence. Students learn clearer self-introductions, basic networking, explaining roles and responsibilities, and introducing people in a professional way.

chapters.description: Introduce yourself professionally, explain your role, and handle simple networking conversations.

lessons.name: Welcome to the Team
lessons.goalEn: Can understand a simple workplace introduction and small talk.
lessons.situation: On your first day, you meet coworkers who introduce themselves and make small talk.
lessons.goalKr: 직장에서의 간단한 소개와 스몰토크를 들을 수 있다.

lessons.name: Your Role Profile
lessons.goalEn: Can read a short role profile and understand basic job information.
lessons.situation: You read a short profile card about a coworker’s job and responsibilities.
lessons.goalKr: 짧은 직무 소개를 읽고 기본적인 직무 정보를 이해할 수 있다.

lessons.name: What Do You Do Here?
lessons.goalEn: Can explain your job and responsibilities using simple professional phrases.
lessons.situation: A coworker asks about your job. You explain what you do in 3–5 sentences.
lessons.goalKr: 간단한 전문 표현으로 자신의 업무와 책임을 설명할 수 있다.

lessons.name: Let Me Introduce You
lessons.goalEn: Can introduce two people and say why they should talk.
lessons.situation: At an office event, you introduce a coworker to a visitor and connect them.
lessons.goalKr: 두 사람을 소개하고 왜 이야기해야 하는지 말할 수 있다.

lessons.name: First Networking Day
lessons.goalEn: Can handle basic introductions, role explanations, and simple networking smoothly.
lessons.situation: Role-play: meet 2 people, introduce yourself, explain your role, and introduce them to each other.
lessons.goalKr: 소개, 직무 설명, 네트워킹을 자연스럽게 할 수 있다.
